task.goal: Record an audio clip using Audio Recorder app and save it.
task.final_summary: Recorded and saved an audio clip in Audio Recorder. I recorded about seven seconds of audio, stopped it, and saved it under the suggested name Record-1. The Records list now shows Record-1 dated Today, 0.09 Mb, M4a, 44.1kHz, duration 00:07.

steps.note: Observe current screen; find Audio Recorder app
Launch Audio Recorder app and observe its main screen
Tap Get started and dismiss intro
Tap Apply on setup screen and continue to main recorder screen
Tap record button and check for permission dialog
Wait 3 seconds, then tap stop to finish the recording
Tap stop button to end recording
Tap Save to store the recording as Record-1
Open records list and confirm Record-1 is saved
